title: Emily Chavez
description: Read books to children at a public library wearing a “protect trans kids” tee shirt.
body:
# Emily Chavez

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/chavez-profile.png)

- Posted on **[social media](https://www.facebook.com/chavez4dps/)** in 2025: “At a time when our communities are being increasingly surveilled, attacked, and racially profiled, the work we do to serve and lead right now is critical.”
- **[Read books to children](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1KE1jyQNzh/)** at a public library wearing a “protect trans kids” tee shirt.

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/Chavez.png)

- One of her **[campaign platforms](https://www.facebook.com/share/1F3zHfzDMx/)** was to hire teachers and staff based on race.

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/chavez2.png)

- Introduced a resolution and voted for March 31, 2025 **[to be celebrated](https://citizenportal.ai/articles/6102641/North-Carolina/Durham-board-unanimously-recognizes-March-31-as-Transgender-Day-of-Visibility?ss=&af=-14087&source=ballotpedia)** in Durham Public Schools as “Transgender Day of Visibility.” The resolution was prompted by a leftist advocacy group, **[Rainbow Collective for Change](https://9thstreetjournal.org/2025/03/28/durham-school-board-vows-to-support-transgender-students/)**.
- Praises Critical Race Theory **[and admits](https://indyweek.com/news/politics/elections/candidate-questionnaire-emily-chavez-durham-board-of-education-district-1/)** it is taught in Durham schools. Chavez said, “CRT is to varying degrees taught within schools; however, it is certainly not a foundational part of each DPS student’s educational experience at this point in time.”
- Regarding LGBTQ students **[she said](https://indyweek.com/news/politics/elections/candidate-questionnaire-emily-chavez-durham-board-of-education-district-1/)**, “we should understand that part of racial equity is creating safety for gender expansive and trans youth, many of whom are students of color and also experience the effects of racism.”
- Chavez said **[she supported](https://indyweek.com/news/politics/elections/candidate-questionnaire-emily-chavez-durham-board-of-education-district-1/)** the “Growing Together” district plan that redistricted students based on racial demographics.
- Chavez called for racial and implicit bias **[training](https://indyweek.com/news/politics/elections/candidate-questionnaire-emily-chavez-durham-board-of-education-district-1/)** for school resource officers (SRO) in schools.
